meta.title: Bandizip archives
meta.description: Without a matching tool in reach, an agent falls back to unpacking file by file — slow, and the directory structure tends to be lost. This plugin puts the installed Bandizip console tool (bz.exe) in the tool surface and registers nine semantic tools, each declaring only the arguments it reads. list_archive lists entries and answers whether the archive is encrypted (ZIP reads the central directory's encryption bit, 7z/RAR get a password-less bz t probe, and a failed probe is reported as unknown) and whether it is split (counted from the .z01/.z02 sibling fragments); extract_archive unpacks into a chosen folder behind three pre-write guards — zip-slip, a declared-size bomb ceiling, and a symlink policy selectable as reject/skip/allow — with archive-internal masks, a dry run, and an optional digest check before anything is written; create_archive packs, appends, splits and encrypts, with an optional bz t check or a roundtrip comparison that unpacks and compares every source file; compress_file / decompress_file handle gz, xz and zstd for a single file (gz and zstd through node:zlib, xz delegated to bz.exe, zstd requiring Node 22.15+ and saying so clearly when absent); check_archive verifies every entry's data with bz t and can compare the artifact against an expected digest; detect_format identifies files by magic bytes (zip, 7z, rar, gz, xz, bzip2, zstd, lzh, tar, iso, cab, self-extracting exe) and only falls back to bz and the extension when no signature matches; diff_archive compares two archives by entry name and size; convert_archive repacks into another format, level or password and verifies the result. Writing supports zip, zipx, 7z, tar, tgz, gz, xz, iso, lzh, and self-extracting exe, and reading also covers rar and other formats; relative paths resolve against the session working directory and nothing opens a window or waits for a prompt. Compression level, overwrite policy, mode, encoding, destination, and timeout are all decided per call rather than fixed in the plugin. Note: passwords are passed to bz.exe as command-line switches, so other processes on this PC can see them; extract_archive requires an explicit destination and overwrite policy; create never replaces an existing archive unless overwriting is enabled and explicitly requested. Turning the plugin off removes the tools.
